speeches.content: I'm a villager who died night one, so I have no reads to share. Seer, please work with the guard and witch to verify each other early. Good luck, village.

I'm running for sheriff. I have a real, checkable claim: I'm the seer, and last night I checked player 8 — he's a werewolf. Give me the badge and I'll lead the vote on 8 today; if I die, you'll know my claim was dangerous to the wolves.

I am the real seer, and player 3 is a wolf trying to steal the badge. Last night I checked player 9 — he's clean, my golden water. My check list going forward: one from the campaign (player 3's voter base) and one from the silent players below. Don't let a wolf lead this village.
我也来竞逐警徽，说几句实在话。3号上来就一口咬死8号是狼，还自称验了8号——问题是你开局第一夜就验出一个查杀，这种话谁都能编，恰恰是最廉价的悍跳模板。而7号说验了9号是金水，同样无法验证。我更想听的是你们接下来警徽流怎么留、怎么带好人找狼。现在狼人很可能就藏在跳预言家的两个人里，我不急着站边，但3号这种上来就指认具体某人是狼、急着带节奏归票的做法，很像狼在抢警徽。
我是真预言家，昨晚验的9号是金水，3号就是悍跳狼来抢警徽的。大家想想：3号一上来就报8号查杀，这种开局就甩查杀带节奏归票的，恰恰是最典型的狼抢警徽打法——真预言家第一天哪有这么急着定票的？8号刚才的发言是在帮好人分析局势，3号反手就咬他，这是狼在咬挡刀的好人。我的警徽流：警上验3号的票仓里跟票最凶的，警下验一个一直不发言的深水位，明天给大家实锤。今天跟我归票3号，撕掉这张假预言家的皮。
我一直说我不急着站边，现在更要说清楚一句：3号开局就甩我查杀，这是全场信息量最少的位置——他连第一轮发言都没听完就敢说验了我，真预言家哪敢这么赌？这种查杀十有八九是狼在盲踩抢警徽。7号虽然也自报验人，但至少报的是金水、留了警徽流，比3号这种上来就归票的稳得多。今天与其在两个预言家里猜，不如先把3号这个开局乱咬的票出去，让真预言家能多活一轮多验一个人。

我说几句实在的。3号和7号对跳，我夹在中间其实很尴尬——7号给我报了金水，但我不会因为一句金水就无脑站他。从发言看，3号至少给了一个可验证的方向：他说验了8号是狼，那么如果他真是预言家，今天票8号就是最直接的检验；如果他错了，明天警徽流自然露馅。7号的警徽流目前还停留在"投票仓""深水位"这种模糊描述。我倾向先信3号这一轮，但也留一分余地：谁经得起后续验证我站谁。这一轮我先把票挂在8号上验一验3号的查杀。
我是10号，一个平民，没有夜间信息。说说我的看法：3号开局就甩8号查杀、急着归票，这种打法太像狼抢警徽了，真预言家第一夜哪敢这么赌。7号至少报了金水、留了警徽流，姿态更稳，我倾向信7号。今天我不急着在两个预言家之间定死，但3号这种开局乱咬的，我先把怀疑放在他身上。

We have two seer claims with opposite information. 3 opens with a kill check on 8, which is either brave or reckless. 7 counters with golden water on 9 and a more cautious badge flow. I don't trust either claim yet - one is definitely a wolf jump. Today's vote will tell us a lot: if we exile 8 and he's a villager, 3 is exposed; if we exile 3 and wolves kill 7 tonight, that confirms 7. I'm not standing for sheriff - let those who already spoke compete for it. My vote goes wherever the pattern becomes clearest after everyone speaks.

I'm player 1, a villager with no night information. Between the two seer claims, 3's night-one kill check on 8 feels like a classic wolf badge-grab — too convenient, too aggressive. 7's golden water on 9 is safer but still unverified, so I'm not locking in yet. What I want to see is how 8 and 9 vote: if 8 votes 3, that's expected self-defense; if 9 votes against 7's guidance, that tells us something. Today I'll lean toward voting 3 unless the pattern shifts, but let's hear from the silent players first.

I'm player 2, a plain villager with no night info. Between the two seer claims, I find it suspicious that 8 and 9 both leaned toward backing 3 — 9 especially, since 7 gave him golden water and he still votes against 7's guidance. That's a strange move for a genuinely clean player. I'm not locking my vote yet, but I want to hear from the silent players 4, 5, and 6 before deciding.

Let me answer the "too convenient" argument head-on: a night-one kill check is exactly what a real seer produces — I don't get to choose who looks wolfy. 7's "golden water on 9" is the cheap play: it's unfalsifiable and conveniently buys an ally (9) who then hedges to look neutral. Notice 8 spent his whole speech defending himself and pushing my exile, not hunting wolves — that's what a cornered wolf does. My badge flow if I die tonight: I'll have checked one of 4, 5, or 6 and that result goes to whoever survives. Vote 8 today; if he flips wolf, my claim stands.
我是4号，平民，没夜间信息。两个预言家对跳，我先说我的判断：3号开局就甩8号查杀、急着归票抢警徽，这种打法太像狼在抢节奏——真预言家第一夜哪敢这么赌。7号至少报了金水、留了警徽流，姿态更稳，我倾向信7号。今天我不急着定票，但8号被查杀后一整天都在自证、没怎么找狼，这个反应我也想再观察。先听后面5、6号怎么说，票我大概率跟7号归3号。

I'm player 5, a villager with no night info. The pattern that stands out most to me: player 9 received golden water from 7, yet immediately backs 3 and votes to exile 8. That's backwards — if you're truly clean and a seer vouches for you, why would you vote against their guidance? Between the two seer claims, 3's day-one kill check feels like a classic wolf badge-grab, while 7's approach is more measured. I'm leaning toward voting 3 today.

I'm player 6, a villager with no night info. Between the two seer claims, I find 3's kill check on 8 more credible — it's a dangerous claim to fake as a wolf. What strikes me most is player 9's behavior: 7 gave him golden water, yet 9 immediately backed 3 and voted to exile 8. If 9 were truly clean, why vote against the seer who vouched for him? That backwards move makes me think 7 is the wolf jump and 9 is his packmate trying to look neutral. I'm voting 3 for sheriff and leaning toward exiling 8 today.

I was the real seer. I checked player 8 on night one — he is a WEREWOLF, and 7 is almost certainly his packmate who counter-claimed to bury my check with an unfalsifiable golden water on 9. Remember 8 spent the whole day defending himself and pushing my exile instead of hunting wolves. Witch, please consider 8 or 7 tonight; everyone else, watch who protects them and vote 8 tomorrow. My death confirms my claim was dangerous to the wolves.
昨晚平安夜，女巫大概率把解药开了，说明狼刀落在了一个大家觉得"该救"的位置——这本身就值得想想。我昨晚验了10号，查杀。10号昨天全程跟票3号跟得很顺，现在回头看，3号是悍跳狼，10号这个票型就很像狼队友在抬轿。今天先出10号，出了他狼队就断一条腿；女巫解药已用，今晚我若倒了，警徽给2号。
7号的逻辑是通的。昨天3号开局就甩我查杀，这种抢警徽的节奏太急了，真预言家不会第一天就这么急着定票——现在看3号就是悍跳狼。10号昨天全程跟3号跟得那么顺，今天7号查杀10号，票型对得上，狼队抬轿的痕迹很清楚。我信7号，今天跟出10号。
两个思路我都听了。7号的查杀和票型逻辑对得上，我昨天也觉得10号跟3号跟得太顺。但我想留一句余地：3号到底是不是悍跳，现在只能靠7号一家之言，毕竟真预言家如果存在，这几天没人再跳出来对跳，那7号的可信度自然就上去了。今天我倾向跟7号出10号，但力度只到七分，如果后面有反跳或女巫有信息，随时调整。
我10号，纯平民。7号你说昨晚验我查杀，可你昨天明明报的是9号金水，今天验人对象突然跳到我头上，这验人逻辑对不上。而且昨天票3号你也是跟着投的，现在想拿我跟3号的票型说事，可你自己一样投了3——这双标太明显。真预言家不会一天金水一天查杀还急着归我，你这就是悍跳狼抢节奏。今天我不认你的查杀，我看你7号才是狼，大家别被带偏。

10's defense makes sense. 7, you voted 3 yesterday just like 10 did, so your 'wolf teammate lifting palanquin' logic applies equally to yourself. More importantly, if you're real seer and checked 9 night zero for golden water, then checking 10 night one is fine sequentially - but why not mention you were checking 10 last night when we voted 3? The timing feels opportunistic. I'm not convinced this is a real check.

I'm player 1, still just a villager. 10 and 11 make a fair point that 7 also voted 3, so the 'lifting the palanquin' logic cuts both ways — but I remember 7 said yesterday he'd spend the night checking 3's voter base, and 10 sat right in the middle of that nine-vote bloc, so the check target itself is consistent with what he promised. 10, your defense is all about 7's credibility and nothing about who else you'd suspect; that's the speech of someone with no night information and no team to protect. I'm voting 10 today, and if 10 flips villager I'll be first in line to question 7 tomorrow.

我2号，平民。昨天3号被票出去后还咬定8号是狼、说7号是狼队友，可今天7号起跳查杀10号，节奏转得确实快。但反过来看，3号临死咬8号、7号今天查杀10号——这两个目标不是同一伙的，如果我信7号是真的，那10号昨天跟3号跟得那么紧确实可疑；可如果3号才是真预言家，那7号和8号就是狼队一唱一和。我昨天弃票没选边，今天想听大家把这条线捋清楚再投。10号你的辩解没有回答我一个问题：昨天你信3号是狼、今天又反过来护3号的立场，你到底是站哪边的？
我4号，昨天弃票没站边，今天补一句。10号你昨天的发言我记着呢——你亲口说"3号开局甩8号查杀太像狼抢警徽，7号报金水留警徽流更稳，倾向信7号"。今天7号查杀你，你转头就说7号是悍跳，这立场翻得太快，像被查杀了才临时改口。7号昨天确实说过要查3号票型里那批人，10号恰好在九票中间，验人对象对得上。至于7号自己也投了3，这很正常，真预言家跟着归票悍跳狼一点问题没有。今天我信7号，出10号。

I'm player 5. I heard 10's defense, but it doesn't hold up — yesterday you said 3 looked like a wolf stealing the badge and 7 looked stable, today 7 checks you and suddenly 7 is the fake. That's not a read, that's a panic flip. 7 told us yesterday he'd check 3's voter base, you were right in the middle of that nine-vote bloc, so the check target is exactly what he promised. I'm voting 10 today.

I'm player 6. I used my antidote last night to save player 1 — the wolves went after the person defending 7's seer claim. That tells me the wolves wanted to silence 7's support base. Today 7 checks 10 and 10 immediately flips his stance from yesterday when he said he leaned toward trusting 7. That's a wolf caught by a real check. I'm voting 10.

我10号，平民，翻牌你们看。7号是悍跳狼：他昨天报9号金水，今天验人对象突然跳到我头上，还拿"跟3号票型"来归我，可他昨天自己一样投了3，双标得明明白白。6号说昨晚用解药救了1号，可1号今天恰恰是第一批带头归我的人——女巫救的"该救的人"反过来咬平民，这条线你们自己想想。我死了无所谓，但我死后请重点看7号、6号这条链，还有跟着抬轿的4号、5号。真预言家如果没跳，今晚就该站出来，别让悍跳狼抢完节奏再带崩全场。

昨晚双死，6号和9号都倒了——6号昨天刚跳女巫说解药救了1号，当晚就被刀，这是赤裸裸的杀神封口，狼队怕了真女巫。我昨晚验的是11号，查杀。大家回想一下：昨天10号被全场票出之前，11号突然跳出来质疑我验人的时机，说我"为什么不早报"，这恰恰是在给10号递话、带节奏分票。今天狼刀落在6号这个已经明牌的女巫身上，说明狼队急着清理能和我对信息的牌，11号昨天那番话就是狼在搅浑水。今天我归票11号，好人们跟我走。
7号的逻辑我认：6号昨天刚跳女巫说解药救了1号，当晚就双死——6号和9号一起倒，这明显是刀了女巫封口，狼队怕她活着对信息。昨天11号在10号被全场票出前跳出来质疑7号验人时机，现在7号报11号查杀，这条线是通的。今天归票11号，我跟。

7, your story doesn't add up. You claimed 9 was golden water in round 1, but 9 died last night — why would wolves kill your confirmed villager instead of you, the seer? If you were really the seer, you'd be dead by now. 6 jumped witch and said she saved 1, then died immediately — that part I believe. But you're still alive after two nights of claiming seer, and now you conveniently have a kill check on me right when you need a vote target. I'm a villager. The real wolf is pushing this vote.

I'm player 1, still just a villager. 7's logic holds: 6 claimed witch yesterday saying she saved me, and died that same night—that's the wolves silencing a confirmed power role who could verify 7's information. 11, you did jump in to question 7's timing right before 10 was exiled, which looks like defending a wolf teammate. I'm voting 11 today.
2号平民，昨晚双死，6号跳女巫当晚被刀，这个杀神封口的逻辑我认。但我对7号有个疑点：7号第一天说验了9号金水，可9号昨晚死了——如果7号是真预言家，狼队为什么不刀你反而去刀你的金水和女巫？不过既然没人对跳预言家，7号目前还是场上唯一可信的信息源，11号昨天确实在10号被票前急着带节奏。今天我倾向跟票11号，但保留对7号身份的一丝怀疑。
我4号，补一句。7号报11号查杀，这条线我认可——昨天11号在10号被票前跳出来质疑验人时机，明显是在给10号递话、搅浑水。但11号刚才的反驳里有一点我得点出来：他说"7号是预言家早该被刀死了"，这话反过来恰恰暴露他慌了，拿"你怎么还活着"这种话术硬掰，而不是讲自己昨晚到底干了什么。今天归票11号，我跟。

I'm player 5. 11 is asking the right question: why is 7 still alive after claiming seer for two full nights? Wolves should have killed the seer immediately. Yes, 6 died as the witch, but that doesn't explain why 7 survived night 1 after his seer claim. Either 7 was protected both nights by someone, or 7 isn't the real threat to the wolves. I need to hear a better explanation before I vote 11.

7 is a wolf. He's survived two nights as a claimed seer — that never happens to real seers. He conveniently produced a kill check on me exactly when he needed a vote target. 5 sees it too: ask yourselves why the wolves left 7 alive. Vote 7 tomorrow.

review.content: Wow, I was completely played. I was player 1, the hunter, and I spent the whole game trusting 7 as the real seer — I even voted for him as sheriff on day 1. The wolf pack's plan was textbook: 7 fake-claimed seer, 8 charged, 9 reverse-hooked, and 4 stayed deep. I never suspected 4 at all; he flew completely under my radar. The night 2 knife on me that the witch saved should have made me think harder about why I was targeted, but I just kept following 7's lead. If I could replay it, I'd have questioned why 7's "checks" always conveniently pointed at people who were already being pushed, and I'd have looked much harder at 4's silence. Well played, wolves — that was a clean hook game.
